Privacy Policy

This policy applies to the Android game Orbit Arrow: Tap & Shoot.

Game progress and preferences

The game saves progress and preferences, including sound and vibration settings, on your device. These saves are used to resume play and apply your settings. You can remove them by clearing the game's storage in Android Settings.

Advertising

The game includes Google AdMob. Google may process IP addresses, device or account identifiers, app interactions, and diagnostic information for advertising, measurement, and fraud prevention. See how Google uses information from partner apps.
